jobs.name: bank-outer
jobs.prompt: Openfold RICH painterly pixel art, crisp deliberate clusters, 64 logical pixels per tile, top-down ground plane, no perspective horizon. Restrained shared green/moss/wood/stone/teal/blue colour families matching the provided own-game reference. No tall plants, reeds, trees, props, foam, waves, shadows or text. Those belong in separate animated layers. Tiny embedded grit and flat moss are allowed; no large raised rocks. No grid lines, separators, labels or margins. Produce a square 3x3 nine-slice terrain atlas, total logical192x192 pixels, displayed enlarged. It must appear as ONE continuous rounded-square island of flat mossy short-turf land with an irregular narrow grey-beige gravel rim, surrounded by TRUE TRANSPARENCY where water will later be. The island occupies x32..160 and y32..160 in the192px logical canvas. Its corner radius32. Thus equal64px grid cells hold: top row NW convex corner / north straight shore with land below / NE convex corner; middle row west straight shore with land right / fully filled plain land / east straight shore with land left; bottom row SW corner / south straight shore with land above / SE corner. Outer corners are convex LAND corners, not holes. Where a shoreline crosses an internal cell boundary it must meet at the half-cell coordinate exactly, with consistent rim thickness of6 logical pixels. Outer32px margin transparent; mild natural pixel irregularity only near the ideal boundary. The centre is quiet green turf with muted bare soil specks. NO rendered water anywhere. All land fully opaque, all space outside island transparent. Exact fixed canvas; not separate icons or miniature islands.
